Subject: Mutual Action Plan Kickoff — SE/ML intro & evaluation milestones

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. As discussed, we put together a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) to make the evaluation and procurement timeline explicit and to align technical owners up front.

Quick introductions for the thread:
- Karthik Iyer (me) — Account Executive, Redwood Inference (owner / commercial lead)
- Irene Choi — Customer Success / Ops lead (Irene will coordinate timelines and enablement)
- Dylan Brooks — Solutions Engineer (technical kickoff & integration owner)
- Marcus Lin — Applied ML engineer (evaluation metrics, model selection)

What I’m proposing next:
1) 45-minute technical kickoff (SE + ML + Aurora platform) to align on data ingress, auth, perf targets, and evaluation dataset.
   - Proposed slots (PT): Wed, Dec 16 11:00–11:45 or Thu, Dec 17 10:00–10:45 — please confirm which works.
2) Shared MAP with milestones (attached):
   - Week 1: test environment access & sample data ingestion
   - Week 2–3: evaluation runs & quality checks (metrics defined by Marcus)
   - Week 4: security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence exchange
   - Commercial: finalize terms and PO during week 5 if targets met
3) Pre-kickoff ask: can you share the expected sample size (rows/documents), whether data will be S3 or direct DB export, and any IP/PII constraints we should be aware of?

Attachments: MAP-draft-Aurora-Health.pdf, evaluation-checklist.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C-Aurora-MAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345-RDW-AUR-73

Thanks — hoping to lock the kickoff time and get Dylan & Marcus up to speed.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan Kickoff — SE/ML intro & evaluation milestones

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear plan. Wed Dec 16 11:00 PT works best for our platform team.

A couple quick items before the kickoff so Dylan & Marcus can prep:
- Our eval set will be ~15K documents (mix of short notes and long discharge summaries). We can provision a gzipped S3 export (we use aws account aurora-eval-data).
- We have strict PHI constraints; we need to confirm redaction options and on-hosting requirements during the kickoff.
- For auth, we prefer short-lived token exchange (OIDC) and will need to review any data flows to Redwood-managed services.

Can you confirm the calendar invite and whether you need any sample records ahead of time? Also please include a quick summary of the perf targets you have in mind so Marcus can align metrics.

—Priya

Head of Platform Engineering, Aurora Health
priya.shah@aurorahealth.com

Great — thanks Priya, Wed 11:00 PT confirmed on my calendar (inv sent). I'll include a short agenda and a tech pre-read.

Pre-kickoff notes / asks from the SE side:
- Data ingress: S3 export is fine. Please share a temporary bucket/path and an IAM role or presigned URL for the dataset. If the data contains PHI, we recommend either field-level redaction prior to upload or provision a private VPC appliance; we can detail both options at the meeting.
- Auth: OIDC short-lived tokens sound good. We'll need a service account for automated eval runs and a list of scopes.
- Network: will Aurora allow outbound connections to redwood inference endpoints from your VPC, or do you prefer a private deployment model (we can discuss Dedicated / Private options).
- Evaluation metrics: Marcus — can you confirm the initial quality metrics (precision@k, ROUGE/F1 for summaries, latency p95 target) you want instrumented?

Attachments referenced in invite: MAP-draft-Aurora-Health.pdf (1.2MB, PDF), evaluation-checklist.xlsx (12KB, XLSX)

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

--

Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
